notes: Updated for Star Citizen 4.10 - Mavin's baked game data is re-extracted from the 4.10 client (build 4.10.191.2241). Mining: three new modules (Clearcut, Deluge, Overrun) and five craftable Ore Pods (Drake, GOLEM MC-4, Argo, MISC, MISC Enhanced); Torrent III and Stampede can now be crafted. Crafting: the blueprint catalog is 1,607 entries, up 13, with nothing removed, and 721 of them now tell you where they come from, up from 678. Two blueprints were renamed by CIG rather than removed, so anything you had marked as known is unaffected. Fixed: the Drake Golem's mining laser was briefly reported with 4 module slots - it has 2; 4.10 changed how the game files describe module ports and our reader miscounted. Minerals, ore quality bands, planet and moon lists and hauling contracts were unchanged by this patch.
